items.title: How OpenAI turned its coding tools into dots, an always-on personal assistant
items.summary: Alexander Embiricos, the OpenAI executive responsible for dots, never wants to have a meeting with someone else's AI agent.
items.author: Tim Fernholz

items.title: Cohere says Alibaba’s Qwen model tried to send a file to Beijing
items.summary: An AI model said it wouldn’t use any tools, then tried to send something to a server in Beijing anyway, and while researchers say it’s probably a training quirk and not espionage, the whole thing has people asking how much to trust free Chinese AI.
items.author: Aditya Mehta

items.title: Anthropic’s IPO filing reveals its strategy for keeping enterprise customers hooked
items.summary: Anthropic’s S-1 shows more than half of its $100,000-plus customers now use both the Claude Platform and a first-party app, a cross-selling playbook reminiscent of Amazon that’s making enterprise customers stickier.
items.author: Rebecca Bellan

items.title: SpaceX locks in $40B GPU financing deal with Apollo
items.summary: The financing gives SpaceX another way to fund its rapidly expanding AI ambitions without relying solely on traditional debt markets.
items.author: Aditya Mehta

items.title: Anthropic officially files for its public debut
items.summary: Anthropic has officially filed for an IPO, revealing soaring revenue, mounting losses, major enterprise adoption, and an unusual governance structure designed to preserve founder control and its AI safety mission.
items.author: Rebecca Bellan
